headline: President Tinubu defends $21.7 billion borrowing program for Nigeria
summary: Nigerian President Bola Tinubu defended $21.7 billion in planned loans, arguing the capital is essential for funding long-term national infrastructure projects.
why: Nigeria is Sub-Saharan Africa's largest economy, balancing high public infrastructure deficits against rising debt service requirements.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Sovereign borrowing expands fiscal debt commitments while funding long-term economic infrastructure.
